missions.phrase: Я рад этой поездке в горы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after adjective. 'Поездке' is the dative required by 'рад', meaning glad about. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative, and 'в горы' is the accusative of direction. A natural feeling pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Поездкой' is the instrumental required by 'довольны', meaning satisfied with. 'Нашей' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A useful satisfaction pattern.

missions.phrase: В поездке мы познакомились с туристами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В поездке' uses the prepositional form 'поездке' after 'в' to mark the setting. 'С туристами' is the instrumental of accompaniment. A natural travel anecdote.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Поездки' is the genitive linking it to 'цель', the purpose of the trip. 'Деловая' is the predicate adjective. A useful pattern for stating purpose.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К поездке' uses the dative form 'поездке' after 'к' to express preparation for. 'Долгой' agrees in the feminine dative. A natural preparation pattern.

missions.phrase: За год мы совершили четыре поездки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular with numeral. After 'четыре' the noun takes the form 'поездки'. 'За год' marks the time span. A useful counting pattern.
